tasks_of_interest.directive: When this block is present, set every "task" field to the SINGLE closest matching label from the list below. Normalize the LABEL ONLY — do not change extraction granularity (entry count still follows what the authors report, per the benchmark_suites rule) and do not normalize "subtask" values (record those verbatim). If no label is a reasonable match, use a concise free-form task name AND add "task label not in provided list" to that entry's notes field, so gaps in the vocabulary are visible.
